messages.content: [system prompt omitted to save space — identical rendering rules as run2-t0.5, prompt revision before the Sunday-hours sentence]
Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
I strained my lower back and the pain is intense. Can you see me today?

If this is an emergency, please hang up and call 119 for an ambulance right away. If it's not an emergency, I can tell you that we do treat back pain. Would you like to know our hours and how to book an appointment?
No, it's not bad enough for an ambulance.

Thank you for clarifying. We're open today until seven in the evening. You can book an appointment through our online reservation form on our website. If you'd prefer to arrange it by phone, I can have a staff member call you back. What would you like to do?
Got it, thank you very much.
